symptom: During an otherwise recoverable page or world transition, the shared route error card can appear before the application succeeds.

root_cause.mechanism: app/error.tsx rendered the terminal error card synchronously while its recovery code only ran later in useEffect. Every recoverable error therefore exposed the terminal surface for at least one paint. app/global-error.tsx had the same ordering flaw.
root_cause.trigger_certainty: The exact production exception that entered the boundary was not captured. Current production transition sampling did not reproduce it, so no unsupported server, cache or RSC trigger claim is made.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: A permanent origin failure is the primary cause.
competing_hypotheses.evidence: The user reports that the destination later succeeds, and 24 sampled public cross-world transitions produced no boundary, page error or failed response.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The service worker serves obsolete rendered HTML.
competing_hypotheses.evidence: The current public worker caches only the offline shell and static assets; navigation remains network-first.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Slow navigation alone renders the error card.
competing_hypotheses.evidence: Cold cross-world transitions were slow, but a delay alone cannot render app/error.tsx without a thrown boundary error.

repair: Show immediate branded navigation feedback while retaining the current page.
Prefetch the four primary world routes after hydration on suitable connections.
Reserve one automatic route or global boundary reset per pathname and minute.
Keep existing release-asset cache cleanup and reload recovery bounded.
Show a concise terminal retry and home action only after bounded recovery is unavailable or exhausted.
Clear pending feedback on commit, same-route activation, explicit finish, back and unmount.

verification.unit: 7/7 focused navigation and recovery tests passed.
verification.build: Full production build, RSC asset verification and worker startup budget passed.
verification.delayed_navigation: Mobile feedback 100ms and desktop feedback 88ms in the final delayed-route audit; old context remained visible; target, back and reload passed.
verification.family: 24/24 local built-candidate transitions across vacation, events, spa and hourly committed without a visible boundary or page error.
verification.production_baseline: 24/24 sampled public transitions committed without a visible boundary; this confirms intermittency, not absence of the user-observed defect.

publication: not performed; not authorized by the current request
